text: {"label":"Treating Escape-Maintained Problem Behavior","definition":"Applied research on assessing and reducing problem behavior maintained by escape from tasks or demands, comparing interventions such as noncontingent reinforcement, reinforcer type and arrangement, and alternatives to escape extinction.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on clinical treatment of escape-maintained problem behavior, unlike basic research on free-operant avoidance, general alternative-reinforcement treatments without extinction, or basic response–reinforcer relations."}
